steps: Pay 147,00 € by January 6, 2027 to IBAN DE18 7409 2000 0001 9944 20 (recipient: Staatskasse Bayern).

final.title: Court payment order from Coburg
steps: If you agree that you owe the money, pay 1.281,00 € plus ongoing interest to the applicant (Kastanienhof Versandhandel GmbH) at account IBAN DE55 5059 2200 0712 3340 61 by 17.12.2026. Do not send payments to the court.

If you dispute all or part of the claim, file an objection (Widerspruch) using the enclosed form with Amtsgericht Coburg by 17.12.2026, quoting the case number Geschäftsnummer 26-4815093-0-7 or Kundennummer KD-55821904.
final.objection: If you dispute the claim in whole or in part, submit an objection (Widerspruch) using the enclosed form to Amtsgericht Coburg by 17.12.2026, stating the case number. If you object, the case will be transferred to Amtsgericht Nürnberg for trial.
final.if_ignored: After the deadline passes, the applicant can apply for an enforcement order (Vollstreckungsbescheid), which allows them to enforce the debt against you, for example by seizing your wages or bank account.

explained.title: Court payment order (Mahnbescheid)

Alternatively, file an objection using the enclosed form with Amtsgericht Coburg and quote reference number Geschäftsnummer 26-4815093-0-7 by December 17, 2026, if you dispute the claim.
explained.if_ignored: The applicant can apply for an enforcement order, which allows them to carry out enforcement measures against you, such as seizing your wages or bank account.

final.title: Penalty Charge Notice for bus lane
steps: Pay £80.00 by 15/12/2026 (within 21 days of the date of notice) to get the 50% discount, or pay £160.00 by 22/12/2026.
Pay online at www.camden.gov.uk/parking using PCN number CU81234567 and vehicle registration LK19 XWD, or call the automated line at 020 7974 4646.
If you were not the keeper of the vehicle on 21/11/2026, tell the council within 28 days and give the keeper's name and address.
final.objection: If you think the penalty is wrongly issued or not owed, you may make representations within 28 days of the date of this notice. If you do so within 21 days, the discount will be held until they reply.
final.if_ignored: If you do not pay or make representations within 28 days, a Charge Certificate may be served and the penalty will increase by 50% to £240.00. If the increased charge is not paid, the Council may register the debt at the Traffic Enforcement Centre and use enforcement agents to recover it.

steps: Pay 705,60 € by December 31, 2026.

Pay at any authorized financial institution using payment reference 41 26 0 112839452 7, or through the Import@ss service on the Social Security Electronic Office (Sede Electrónica de la Seguridad Social).
If you cannot pay on time, you can request a payment deferral (aplazamiento) before December 31, 2026.
final.objection: You can file an appeal (recurso de alzada) with the Provincial Directorate within one month from the day after you receive this notice. Filing an appeal does not pause collection unless the debt is guaranteed or the amount is deposited.
final.if_ignored: If you do not pay by the deadline, an enforcement order (providencia de apremio) with a 20% surcharge will be issued, and seizure proceedings against your assets, bank accounts, and credits will begin, with costs charged to you. Unpaid debt can also block access to benefits such as temporary disability or cessation of activity.

final.title: Speeding fine notice
steps: Pay the reduced fine of 45 € by December 10, 2026 (or by December 25, 2026 if paying online) using notice number 8 4126 3359 0471 8 and payment code 4126 3359 0471 8 06.
You can pay online at www.amendes.gouv.fr, by phone at 0 811 10 20 30, or by stamp-fine (timbre-amende).
If you were not the driver, name the actual driver at www.antai.gouv.fr within 45 days, before January 9, 2027.
final.objection: To contest the fine, send a request for exemption (requête en exonération) to the Public Prosecutor's Office (Officier du ministère public) within 45 days, before January 9, 2027. Do not pay the fine if you contest it.
final.if_ignored: If you do not pay or contest within 45 days (by January 9, 2027), the fine increases to 180 € and collection is handed over to the Public Treasury (Trésor public).

explained.title: Speeding fine notice
steps: Pay the reduced fine of 45 € before December 10, 2026 by mail, or before December 25, 2026 online at www.amendes.gouv.fr or by phone at 0 811 10 20 30, using notice number 8 4126 3359 0471 8 and payment code 4126 3359 0471 8 06.
Alternatively, if you were not the driver, you can name the actual driver at www.antai.gouv.fr by January 9, 2027.
To contest the fine, send an application for exoneration to the Public Prosecutor (Officier du ministère public) within 45 days, and do not pay the fine.
explained.if_ignored: If you do not pay or contest within 45 days, the fine increases to 180 € and collection is handed over to the public treasury.

final.title: Notice to submit additional visa documents
steps: Prepare a resident tax taxation certificate and tax payment certificate for the most recent year, issued at your ward office.
Prepare a certificate of employment issued by your affiliated organization, created on or after December 1, 2026 (or December 11, 2026; see unclear items).
Prepare a document specifically describing your job duties, signed by the representative of your affiliated organization.
Make a copy of this notice and place it on top of the other documents.
Attach Japanese translations to any documents that are in a foreign language.

Submit all documents by December 18, 2026, either by bringing them to the Employment Examination Division 2 counter, by sending them via simplified registered mail with "資料提出 2026-T-0584621" written in red on the front of the envelope, or online via the Residence Application Online System if you applied online.
If you cannot submit the documents by December 18, 2026, contact the office in charge before the deadline.
final.if_ignored: If you do not submit the documents by the deadline, your application will be reviewed using only the documents already submitted, and as a result, your application may be denied.
corrected: read as "技術:人工知識・国際業務", understood as "技術・人文知識・国際業務" (Engineer / Specialist in Humanities / International Services)
read as "当局労務署第二部門", understood as "当局就労審査第二部門" (Employment Examination Division 2)
read as "簡易書面", understood as "簡易書留" (simplified registered mail)
read as "引き続き滞在に在留できます" / "引き継ぎ継続在留できます", understood as "引き続き適法に在留できます" (you can continue to stay legally)
read as "政策審議第二部門" / "就労署第二部門", understood as "就労審査第二部門" (Employment Examination Division 2)

explained.title: Notice to submit additional documents for visa renewal
steps: Obtain a certificate of residence tax taxation and a certificate of tax payment (most recent 1 year) issued by the ward office.
Obtain a certificate of employment created by your organization on or after 2026年12月1日.
Obtain a certificate describing your job duties in detail, signed by the representative of your organization.
Prepare a copy of this notification letter to place on top of the submitted documents.
Attach Japanese translations to any foreign language documents.

Submit the documents by bringing them to the counter of the Immigration Bureau or by mailing them via registered mail with 2026-T-0584621 written in red on the front of the envelope, or submit them online through the residence application online system by 2026年12月18日.
explained.if_ignored: If you do not submit the documents by the deadline, the review will be conducted using only the documents currently submitted, which may result in your application being denied.

final.title: Court demand for payment of unpaid loan
steps: Pay 398,084円 (plus 14.6% annual late damages on 392,500円 from December 1, 2026 until paid in full) directly to the creditor, not to the court.

If you disagree with the claim or want to request installment payments, fill out the enclosed objection form (督促異議申立書) and submit it to the Tokyo Summary Court in person or by mail by December 17, 2026 (assuming the letter was delivered on December 3, 2026).
final.objection: Submit the enclosed objection form (督促異議申立書) to the Tokyo Summary Court in person or by mail within 2 weeks of receiving the letter (by December 17, 2026, if delivered on December 3, 2026). Filing an objection moves the case to a regular lawsuit at your local court, and you can also use the form to request installment payments.
final.if_ignored: If you do not pay or file an objection within 2 weeks of receiving this letter, the court will issue a declaration of provisional execution at the creditor's request, allowing the creditor to seize your salary, bank deposits, or other assets.
corrected: read as "管領異動" and "管財異議", understood as "督促異議" (objection to demand for payment).
read as "期首の利金", understood as "期間の利益" (benefit of time / right to pay in installments).
read as "仮言宣言", understood as "仮執行宣言" (declaration of provisional execution).
read as "強硬執行", understood as "強制執行" (compulsory execution / asset seizure).
read as "令和年12月3日", understood as "令和8年12月3日" (December 3, 2026).

explained.title: Payment Demand from Tokyo Summary Court
steps: Check the details of contract number SF-7720-415083.
If you disagree with the claim, fill out the enclosed objection form and submit it to the court by December 17, 2026 (令和8年12月17日), either by bringing it in person or by mail.
Pay the total amount of 398,084円 directly to the creditor, not to the court.
explained.if_ignored: If you do not file an objection within two weeks from the service of this demand, the creditor can request a provisional execution order, and your salary, bank deposits, or other assets may be seized through compulsory enforcement.

final.title: Request for supplemental visa extension documents
steps: Prepare a job-seeking activity plan (구직활동계획서) covering the next 6 months, signed by you.
Prepare proof of residence (체류지 입증서류): a copy of your lease contract or a confirmation of accommodation provided.
Prepare a bank balance certificate (잔고증명서) in your name, issued within the last 1 month.

Submit all three documents by December 11, 2026, either by uploading them to the HiKorea e-Application portal or by submitting them in person at the 3rd-floor Residence Management Division counter (bring this notice and your passport if visiting in person).
If you have difficulty submitting by the deadline, submit a written explanation before the deadline to request a one-time extension.

final.title: Advance notice of parking violation fine
steps: Pay the discounted fine of 96,000원 by December 22, 2026 to virtual account 612-907-33182-04 (account holder: 수원시영통구청), or pay via Wetax or ARS 1588-0110.
If you disagree with the fine, submit a written opinion (의견서) by December 22, 2026.
If someone else was driving the vehicle, submit a driver confirmation (운전자 확인서) by December 22, 2026 so the fine is transferred to the actual driver.
final.objection: If you have an objection, submit a written opinion (의견서) by December 22, 2026. If no opinion is submitted by the deadline, it will be treated as having no objection.
final.if_ignored: If you do not pay or submit an opinion by December 22, 2026, the full fine of 120,000원 will be formally imposed. If you miss the payment deadline after that, a 3% late fee plus monthly additional late fees (up to 75%) will be added, and continued non-payment can lead to your license plate being seized or your property being attached.

final.objection: If you have an objection to the medical bill, you can apply for a medical fee verification with the Health Insurance Review and Assessment Service within 3 years from the date of treatment by calling 1644-2000 (no area code needed).

final.title: Overdue water bill and shutoff notice
steps: Pay 156,890원 by December 15, 2026, using one of the following methods:
Bank transfer to virtual account 309-1121-0738-44 (account holder: 부산상수도사업본부) -).
Online banking or the Busan Waterworks website/app by looking up notice number B-2026-12-0061583 and paying by card or bank account.
In person at 방문 동부사업소 Billing Division (1st floor) with your ID card.
By phone (ARS) at 1588-0121 using a credit or debit card.
If you have already paid, keep your receipt and call 051-669-5732 to inform them, as payment confirmation can be delayed.
final.objection: If you disagree with the usage or charges, you can submit a written objection within 14 days of receiving this notice, during which the water shutoff will be suspended. Basic livelihood security recipients, single-person households aged 65 or older, and households with infants can apply for a shutoff deferral, and if a water leak caused high usage, you can submit a repair receipt for a fee reduction.
final.if_ignored: Your water supply will be shut off on December 17, 2026 without further notice, and a 10,000원 reconnection fee will be added to your next bill. Continued non-payment can also lead to property seizure under the Local Tax Collection Act.
corrected: read as "상습사업부부", understood as "상수도사업본부" (Waterworks Headquarters)
read as "남부하실" / "남부하심", understood as "납부하실" (to be paid)
read as "남부기간", understood as "납부기한" (payment deadline)
read as "금수", understood as "급수" (water supply)
read as "채납", understood as "체납" (arrears / overdue)
read as "수수 예정일", understood as "단수 예정일" (scheduled water shutoff date)
